subject: [hw] opus-hevcdec -> V40: patch proposal for VDEC GCE register-condition events (HEIF only; HEVC video uses no GCE)
body:
Finding [V]: Vdec_Drv_H265_open (drv 0x93c44-0x93c72) enables GCE (inst+0xd0 = property vendor.mtk.vdec.h265.gce, default 1) only when its 6th argument is 0x1c ([I] HEIF/still image; forcing that branch gives a 2560x240 grid geometry). HEVC video on the host: 0 GCE flushes in 18 frames. So nothing is needed for H.264/HEVC video.

For HEIF (if ever wanted): gce_event_irq() maps every VDEC event to an IRQ wait, but VDEC events 5-10 (LAT 21-26) are register conditions (mtk_vcu_controls.h:106-150 text): all_dram idle MISC 0x110..0x13c = 0, ini_fetch VLD(58) bit0=1, process_flag VLD(61) bit15=0, start code HEVC_VLD(37) bit8=0 / AVC_VLD(182) bit0=0, ref reorder HEVC_VLD(37) bit4=0 / AVC_VLD(139) bit0=1, wp table HEVC_VLD(37) bit0=0 / AVC_VLD(140) bit0=1. A list waiting on them would time out. Proposal: gpu/hwcodec/fakevdec_hevc/v40-gce-vdec-events.patch (88 lines, against n2vcu.c c70a4bca, git apply --check clean): gce_vdec_cond_event() turns those waits into RWVC_OP_POLL ops (LAT variants on 0x11000/0x15000/0x10000; HEVC vs AVC chosen by whether the list wrote HEVC_VLD), falls back to the IRQ path when the window is not mapped; event 1/LAT 1 stay IRQ waits. With it applied to a /tmp copy: N2TEST V40 PASS 1536/1536 (no new unit test added - yours to add if you take it). Low priority; your call.
